description.value: Spirit Ridge Vineyard Resort & Spa is a resort property in the South Okanagan region of British Columbia, operating under the Hyatt Unbound Collection brand based on its website domain. The name suggests vineyard-integrated accommodations in one of Canada's warmest and driest wine-producing regions. Touring cyclists routing through the Okanagan would find this a high-end destination-stop option in an area known for its scenic cycling through wine country and desert landscape.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a Hyatt bot-protection error page (E6020), making it functionally a fetch failure — no amenity, contact, or operational detail could be extracted from the website. All amenity fields default to null. OSM tags confirm only the name, address, and Hyatt-branded website URL; the resort's Okanagan coordinates and 'looks_closed: false' flag support a confirmed_open determination. No cyclist-specific amenity evidence is available from any source.
concerns: Website fetch failed due to Hyatt bot/browser-detection protection (HTTP error E6020); no amenity or contact detail could be verified from the website. All amenity fields are null.
OSM address lacks city, province, and postal code — full address unverifiable.
No phone number in OSM or retrievable from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, established Hyatt-affiliated resort property in the Okanagan; OSM shows looks_closed=false and there is no evidence of closure or phantom listing. Include as a high-end accommodation option for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone numbers shown on the error page (1-800-720-0059, +1-402-593-5064) are Hyatt's central reservations lines, not Spirit Ridge-specific contact numbers, and have not been recorded.
